scope: Actual built content script; synthetic local fixture; no live video or model acceptance
checks: Old seek, language, retried snapshot and replaced-session errors cannot destroy the current player
A retried playing snapshot cannot override a newer pause in the same epoch
A stale session-scoped stop cannot detach the new player
Delivery ACK rejects old-language and wrong-video audio
Switching back to the same language retains language-version isolation
A current terminal error detaches once and restores the original mute setting
Changing the src of a reused generic video element detaches old translation and restores the original volume
